notes.title: April 9th Update
notes.content:
Fixed some slight issues, and possibly improved the performance.

[list]
[*] Player voice is less annoying
[*] You can now use the map anywhere after interacting with it once, and then holding M
[*] Fixed where you would know about the handgun without actually finding it.
[*] (Hopefully) Improved performance
[/list]

I'll update further in future if I am made aware of more issues. Currently working on another game, stay tuned for updates in future.

notes.title: April 5th patch notes
notes.content:
[u][b]Fixed some slight errors[/b][/u]
[list]

[*] Fixed an issue where you could talk to Jundo, and you would keep gaining knowledge about a robbery.

[*] Fixed the vignette filter in the town, where it disabled itself on startup. 

[*] Fixed an issue with the town map (Again), sometimes it works sometimes it doesn't. As a solution, try to remember the areas instead.
[/list]

[i]That's all for now, feel free to let me know about more bugs that you encounter, and I will do my best to fix them.[/i]
